title: On-call Handoff Draft - Lina Zhou
content:
Shift: 2025-11-02 08:00 -> 2025-11-02 20:00 PT
Owner: Lina Zhou (taking notes during shift)
Summary: Quiet morning, small spike in upstream request latency around 09:15 that resolved after autoscaler warm-up. One pager-notification to #alerts but no P1. Spent time validating a cron job that was timing out (see ongoing tasks).

Active items:
- Ongoing: cron-job node-reconciler failing on some Dedicated hosts (started 2025-11-01). Symptoms: job times out after 3m with transient 502s from internal-gateway. Temporary workaround applied: increased timeout to 6m and added retry backoff in k8s job spec. See k8s job logs: /var/logs/infra/cron-node-reconciler-*.
- Metrics: small increase in kv-cache miss rate for model-variants v1.2.1 around 09:10-09:30 (0.5%->2%). Likely due to redeploy of v1.2.1 on eu-west-1 for patch. Dashboard: Observability -> Per-model KV cache.
- Alerts: No active P1/P2. Alerts triggered and cleared: INFR-KV-MISS (09:12) auto-resolved after rollout completed.

Temporary procedures / runbook notes (draft):
1) If cron-job node-reconciler fails repeatedly (>3 consecutive failures):
   - Check job logs: kubectl -n infra logs job/node-reconciler-<id>
   - Check internal gateway health: curl -sS http://internal-gateway.local/health (status should be 200)
   - If gateway 502s, check gateway pods: kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=internal-gateway; check pod logs for upstream timeouts.
   - Temporary mitigation: scale internal-gateway deployment to +1 replica (kubectl scale deploy internal-gateway --replicas=<current+1>) and restart job.
   - If failures persist after scaling, escalate to Platform Engineering (Slack: #platform-oncall) and open JIRA ticket with job logs and timestamps.

2) For KV cache miss spike:
   - Confirm whether a rollout was happening: check Deployments -> model-variants -> recent rollouts.
   - If rollout in-progress: expect transient miss increase; monitor for >10 minutes.
   - If no rollout, check cache-tier hosts for memory pressure (node-exporter metrics) and restart cache process if OOM observed.

Escalation contacts:
- Primary: Evan Brooks (platform, pager) - Slack: @evan, phone: +1-555-0102
- Secondary: Maya Singh (serving runtime) - Slack: @maya, phone: +1-555-0167
- SRE Lead (for P1): Jonah Reyes - Slack: @jonah, pager (team rota)

Recent changes to be aware of:
- v1.2.1 model-variant rollout to eu-west-1 (2025-11-02 08:45) with kernel selection change that briefly increased cache misses. Change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/318
- Autoscaler config tweak deployed to reduce cold-start latency for hosted-api in us-west-2 (refer PR in linked_artifacts).

Notes to self / TODOs for next shift:
- Follow up with infra team on root cause of internal-gateway 502s seen by node-reconciler last night. Collect pprof from gateway if repeat occurs.
- Add a short playbook snippet under Confluence for "cron-job timeout vs gateway 502" with concrete troubleshooting commands and log locations.
- Validate longer-term fix for node-reconciler: consider implementing exponential backoff instead of fixed retries.

Unresolved questions:
- Why did the node-reconciler see 502s only on a subset of Dedicated hosts? Networking ACLs on those hosts seem identical. Might be intermittent host-level resource saturation.
- Can we add more granular per-host telemetry for the gateway to correlate connection resets?

Quick runbook references (links):
- Oncall Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Oncall+Playbook
- Cron-job troubleshooting doc (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Cron+Jobs

If you take over my shift, TL;DR: current system state is stable, one ongoing cron-job issue with temporary workaround, monitor KV cache metrics for regression, escalate to Evan or Maya if you see repeated failures or new P1.

Signed-off: Lina Z.
